text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaghh! It's raining creepy bugs!
Why, you... You just wait... I'll murder you...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……きゃぁぁぁ！
　変な虫が降ってくるぅぅ！
てんめぇ……、
後で絶対……
ぶっ殺す……！！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh dear. Looks like the tanuki's illusions got her again.
She acts so standoffish, but maybe she's the most innocent of us all?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～あ、
キャルちゃんまたやられちゃったみたいですね……
突っ張ってるように見せて、
本当は人一倍素直なのでしょうか。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Ahh... Miss Karyl... You poor thing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ……
キャルさま……
おいたわしい……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
Well then, this time I think it's my turn to wake her up!
One... two...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ今度は
わたしが気付けを行いますね☆
せぇ～のっ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
No need for that! I'm good! Seriously!
Don't even touch me! Thanks but no thanks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはいい！
　結構！！
　
絶対！！！
触らないで！！！！
　
助けてくれてありがと！！！！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
The sheer dread snapped me right out of it...
Any later, and I'd have been a goner...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あまりの悪寒に目が覚めたわ……
死ぬところだったじゃない……
